intro: With a built-in locker with a hidden compartment, a precision-cut security key, roomy shelves and a lockable drawer for daily storage, Wardrobe H looks after your belongings as well as your clothes.

features.title: Built-in locker for documents, valuables and private keepsakes
features.text: Papers, jewellery and personal belongings deserve a dedicated spot rather than an open shelf. Wardrobe H includes a locker, so you can put away what matters most and keep it out of curious little hands and prying eyes. It suits households with children, where some things need to stay out of reach.

features.title: Secret compartment for an extra layer of safekeeping
features.text: Some belongings call for more discretion. The locker in Wardrobe H has a concealed compartment of its own, giving you a second, less obvious place for the most important items.

features.title: Precision-dimple security key for dependable locking
features.text: The key to Wardrobe H has precision dimples cut with computer-monitored accuracy, which makes it very difficult for another key to open the wardrobe. You get a stronger sense of security with no extra effort.

features.title: Spacious shelves for neatly folded clothes and everyday essentials
features.text: Wardrobe H has roomy shelves where folded clothes, linens and accessories can sit in tidy stacks, so finding what you need takes a glance rather than a rummage.

features.title: Lockable drawer for small valuables within easy reach
features.text: Small things are the easiest to lose. The drawer in Wardrobe H closes with a lock, so watches, cash, spare keys and accessories stay safe while remaining close at hand. It also keeps the shelves clear of clutter.

features.title: Sturdy handle with a comfortable grip
features.text: The handle on Wardrobe H is sturdy and shaped for a comfortable grip, so opening and closing it feels smooth and secure, and it adds a stylish finishing touch to the front.
